episodes.title: The 1800s Vegan Cult That Forgot How to Farm
episodes.description:
In June 1843, transcendentalists Bronson Alcott and Charles Lane bought 90 acres in Harvard, Massachusetts to build "Fruitlands"—a sin-free utopian vegan commune where carrots, coffee, warm baths, wool, and even animal labor were strictly forbidden. Unsurprisingly, starting a farm with zero farming experience and refusing to plant crops until mid-summer turned into one of the most absurd disasters in 19th-century history.

From "aspiring vegetables" and linen shoes in freezing New England winters to an eccentric cast of recruits—including a nudist, a professional swearer, and a man who went to jail to defend his beard—here is the true story of the 1800s vegan cult that forgot how to farm, and the 10-year-old girl who survived it to write an American classic.
